title: Gravity, Mass and Weight
summary: Why things fall, why weight is a force, and why you’d weigh less on the Moon but have the same mass.

ib.note: W = mg is formalised in MYP 4–5

objectives: I can explain gravity as a non-contact force of attraction between masses.
I can distinguish between mass (kg) and weight (N).
I can calculate weight using weight = mass × gravitational field strength.
misconceptions: Mass and weight are the same thing.
Heavy objects fall faster than light ones (without air resistance, they fall together).
There is no gravity in space or on the Moon.
